subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Common
solution:
The correct answer is '**Rare**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word '**Common**' refers to an occurrence that happens often or is widespread. (सामान्य)
 
• The correct antonym, '**Rare**', signifies something that does not occur often or is not found in large numbers. (दुर्लभ)
 
• Hence, the correct antonym for '**Common**' is '**Rare**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is- “**Option 1**”.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Ordinary**' refers to the normal or usual. (साधारण)
 
• '**Boring**' means not interesting or tedious. (उबाऊ)
 
• '**Shocking**' means surprising or upsetting. (चौंका देने वाला)
